summary: Adding one precise, source-anchored scoping statement to the record so the reported defect is not confused with the member's other duties. The proposal gate covers only the MsgProp entry points of the Node API: Propose, ProposeConfChange and Step with a MsgProp all end in the same wait on the proposal channel that the run loop receives from only while its gate is armed, whereas every other message type including MsgIndex requests travels the receive channel. A member whose gate is disarmed therefore has proposals and configuration proposals held while its read-index forwarding, message handling, replication and application are not routed through the gate. The statement is recorded as behaviour knowledge with its source anchors and is explicitly marked as source-derived and not yet executed; a read-index control on the same member is the planned probe, and the harness has been extended to capture read states from Ready so that control can observe a read-index completion while a proposal is held. No experiment is submitted and no execution is requested this turn; all four questions stand explained with their evidence, controls and remaining limits recorded.
